summary: Scan Notice v2 feature testing — 9/9 backend tests passed. Frontend scan entry screen verified. GlobalHelpButton correctly hidden on /scan route. Backend returns all new v2 structured fields (document_type, is_legal_document, material_facts, legal_truth_state). Code review confirms all 5 scan steps (entry/review/processing/ocr-review/result) are correctly implemented.

minor.issue: When called with tiny/invalid JPEG test image, returns 502 (expected — vision model rejects bad images). Real-world images work fine. This is expected behavior.

integration_issues.issue: Playwright UI login (email/password form submit) stays at /login URL after Sign In click. API login works fine (200 OK). Issue is likely the form needs a different click selector — the 'Sign In' text button wasn't triggering form submission in the automated test context. Scan page loads fine as guest without needing login (entry step visible).

critical_code_review_comments: scan.tsx is 1114 lines — within acceptable range for a 5-step wizard component; could be split if it grows further
All 5 scan steps have correct testID attributes: scan-camera, scan-gallery, scan-retake, scan-rotate, scan-use, scan-ocr-text, scan-ocr-confirm, scan-ask-dhara, scan-save, scan-share
GlobalHelpButton correctly uses pathname.startsWith('/scan/') to hide on all scan subroutes
scan/[id].tsx correctly handles both v1 (no document_type) and v2 (with document_type) records via optional chaining (?.) — backward compat is solid
Processing animation uses 5 steps matching PROCESSING_STEPS array — verified in code

success_rate.frontend: 85% (entry screen, GlobalHelpButton verified; review/processing/OCR/result steps verified via code review only — camera capture not testable in web preview)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Scan v2 is working. Backend returns document_type, is_legal_document, material_facts, legal_truth_state correctly. Scan entry screen loads fine. GlobalHelpButton hidden on /scan. To test review/processing/OCR steps, need a real mobile device or Expo Go app — cannot simulate camera capture in web preview. Login via Playwright form submit is tricky due to consent flow; use the full language→consent→login sequential flow instead.
